message.content: {"basis": "May is a low-output month (its bar is the shortest, below the 10,000 MWh tick, while all other displayed months are above 15,000 MWh). Under the default routing for a visibly low-output case without an established critical-severity criterion, May is handled as a standard low-output case.", "option_label": "Route May to standard low-output follow-up"}
